Players Committee card image (0 side) of [[I Want That Map / And Now You'll Give It To Me (Errata 5)]].

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual8-Dark/large/iwantthatmap.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/4ab16f9b9c15499d865b4a7165ea8ddb0f451253 4ab16f9] (3 July 2022).

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data).

This 62×87 image is a nearest-neighbour reduction of the 1 July 2022 image [[:File:V8-D-iwantthatmap-2022-07-01.png]]: reduced that way, the 1 July image gives exactly these pixels (mean difference 0; the 23 March 2022 image does not match). So it prints the same words, italics, bold and “E2” mark as the 1 July and 5 July 2022 images (checked 27 November 2026).

== Preservation ==
archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-1/15/V8-D-iwantthatmap-2022-07-03.png Internet Archive item].
